axes.model_access: Powered by Google Gemini; the model generation and available features vary by Workspace edition, region and administrator settings.
axes.runtime: Runs in Google Workspace’s cloud, with entry points in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet and the Gemini app; no model runs locally.
axes.local_files: Works from Drive documents, email and meeting content; local files must be uploaded or authorised by the client and are not automatically in context.
axes.background: Meeting summaries and email-thread summaries are generated inside the relevant app; there is no persistent cross-session background agent, and long work returns to the conversation.
axes.tools: Integrated with Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides and Meet; external data can be reached through Workspace extensions and third-party connectors.
axes.context: Context comes from Drive and Workspace data the current account can access; cross-session memory and organisational scope are controlled by administrator policy.
axes.permissions: Admins control Gemini features, data access and logs; commercial use depends on the Workspace edition and Gemini add-on licence, and data terms follow the enterprise contract.
axes.fit: Fits: email drafting, document summarisation, spreadsheet analysis and meeting follow-up for Google Workspace teams. Does not fit: replacing professional financial modelling or legal review.
